label: Bandung
short_description: Hotels clustered around the Dago area in this cool-climate West Java highland city.
intro: Bandung's hotels in this directory cluster in and around the Dago area of the West Java highland capital -- a cooler-climate city popular with Jakarta weekenders for its culinary scene, factory outlets and colonial-era architecture. The mix runs from a historic Tribute Portfolio landmark to modern select-service and lifestyle hotels. Bandung is reached via Husein Sastranegara Airport (BDO) or the toll road and high-speed rail from Jakarta.
